Codex CLI bumped to version that refuse install helper binaries when `CODEX_HOME` sit under `/tmp`.

Exact stderr each failed test:
```
Refusing to create helper binaries under temporary dir "/tmp" (codex_home: AbsolutePathBuf("/tmp/codex-home-..."))
```

Source: `e2e/agents/codex.go:65-71` call `os.MkdirTemp("", "codex-home-*")`. Empty first arg = `$TMPDIR` which on GH Actions Linux runner = `/tmp`. New codex guard reject it.

Cascading effect: codex start emit WARNING, fail install PATH helpers → later tool calls (`apply_patch`, `shell`, `functions`) break → assertions fail (missing files, missing rewind points, missing `Entire-Checkpoint` trailer). Many tests also hit `patch rejected: empty patch` / `NameError: name 'functions' is not defined` downstream from same broken env.

Macro (claude/cursor/gemini etc jobs) unaffected — only codex codepath use `CODEX_HOME`.

Fix: move CODEX_HOME outside /tmp. E.g. `os.MkdirTemp(filepath.Join(os.Getenv("HOME"), ".cache"), "codex-home-*")` or pass `e2e/artifacts/<ts>/codex-home-*` dir. Also check if upstream expose env to waive check.

Want me patch it?
